hypotheses retain supporting and disconfirming evidence

modes.expansion: two-to-four useful dimensions plus one boundary
four-to-eight dimensions with omissions and uncertainty

operational_intelligence.purpose: Compare forms, states, transitions, loss, drift, gates, and return readiness without selecting authority or truth.
projection_requirements: source digest or revision when available
operational_intelligence.rehydration_rule: Consequential dependence requires direct source reinspection when freshness, completeness, or digest identity is uncertain.

normative_terms.SHOULD: strong default whose exception must be explained
normative_terms.HOLD: stop the dependent action and preserve evidence
normative_terms.UNKNOWN: unresolved value that cannot become permission

governance.validation_limit: A check establishes only its declared predicate; it does not establish acceptance, meaning, safety, usefulness, or runtime efficacy.

source_relation: Public adaptation with deliberate loss; private source bodies and personal context are excluded and no write-back is permitted.
